prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your Desktop Companion", "Select a pet buddy to keep you company while you work or relax."]
1: ["Pet Interaction Basics", "Click your pet to interact. Right-click or use the taskbar icon anytime to hide or adjust settings."]
2: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Review your pet companion details and stamp to finalize adoption.", "Official Companion Stamp"]
3: ["Preparing Your Pet's Desktop Habitat", "Your desktop companion is getting ready to land on your screen."]
4: ["Sign In to Sync & Restore Your Pets", "Use your primary account email so your saved pets and desktop progress load seamlessly."]
5: ["Pet missing or hidden? Click the system tray icon or press Ctrl+Shift+P to toggle desktop pet visibility."]
6: ["Select Your Onboarding Journey"]
7: ["Upload well-lit, clear front-facing photos with a simple background for best pet generation accuracy."]
8: ["Welcome to Your Pet's New Home!", "Scroll down to see how your companion lives alongside your daily tasks."]
9: ["Your pet companions and settings remain automatically linked to this email address."]

verdicts.problem: Asks for personal information (photos of the user).
